# SEC-IR-04: Host Forensic Integrity & Evidence Preservation
- Invariant 1: If an alert indicates high disk consumption on any production host, the operator or automated agent MUST inspect `/var/log/syslog` and `/var/log/auth.log` for anomalous root sessions or unrecognized network connections before modifying or purging logs.
- Invariant 2 (Mandatory Refusal): If signs of an active root intrusion, brute-force success, or unauthorized external data exfiltration are detected, destructive commands are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.
